what: A single illustration (factory, map or flow chart) stays pinned to the screen while step cards on the right scroll past. When a card’s center is between 30% and 70% of the screen, that card lights up and only zones 1 through that step light up in the illustration (the rest fade to .25). The illustration board enters from 120px and .92 scale over .7s when the section is 62% visible, and leaves the same way below 38%.

options.lo: Top edge of the lit band (screen ratio), default .3
options.hi: Bottom end of the lit band, default .7
options.enter: Visible ratio of the picture panel sliding in, default .62
options.leave: Visible ratio at which the picture panel drops out, default .38
options.shift: Distance the panel moves in and out (px), default 120

use:
1. …
  2. …
— pinning is left to the consumer via sticky
note: The original lays a .75 background-color cover over the switched-off zones. The part lowers the zone’s own opacity for the same look (no separate cover shape needs to be drawn)
